notes: Model name in APC/Schneider literature is "Rack PDU, Basic, 1U, 20A, 120V, (10)5-20; 5-20P" (also listed as "NetShelter Basic Rack PDU"). This is a basic (non-metered, non-switched) rack PDU: one 20A circuit breaker, no monitoring/networking. Connector taxonomy provided has no NEMA 5-20 option (5-15 or 5-20 both map to a generic NEMA 15A duplex); nema-5-15 was used as the closest available id for both the 10 output receptacles (actually NEMA 5-20R) and the input plug (actually NEMA 5-20P) — actual receptacle/plug type is NEMA 5-20, rated 20A/120V, not the 15A 5-15 variant implied by the taxonomy id. Ships with both horizontal and vertical mounting brackets (unit is 1U horizontal form factor, 17.6 in wide). A companion inlet/outlet variant AP9564 uses a NEMA L5-20 twist-lock inlet instead — do not confuse with AP9563.

ports.name: Output 1-10 (NEMA 5-20R)
ports.note: Actual connector is NEMA 5-20R (20A/120V duplex); represents all 10 identical output receptacles on the strip

ports.name: AC In (NEMA 5-20P)
ports.note: Actual connector is NEMA 5-20P attached to a captive 12 ft (3.66 m) power cord, 120V/20A max input
